notes: «أحد ابنى أم هانئ» is named in the text as «اسمه جعدة» and is read as the link جعدة (rule 8 logic)
«جدته» is read as أم هانئ from «وكانت أم هانئ جدته» (occurrence 2), not as a bare relation
Two remarks name other transmitters for the same saying (Abu Salih and our family; Hammad b. Salama): variant groups, never routes (rule 4)
